name: faff
description: Use when invoking /faff without a specific sub-skill, or choosing between planning new work, prioritising, grooming, preparing a ticket, building, onboarding and unattended delivery.

name: faff-beep-boop
description: Run ready work unattended: tidy, drain prep, then drain builds. Parks ambiguity for /faff-wtf. Use for overnight, fire-and-forget or running the backlog.

name: faff-graft
description: Build an existing issue: check its spec, create a worktree and commit the spec to the feature branch. Use for graft, start or pick up an issue.

name: faff-jot
description: Start something new. Kick off an empty project, or capture a new feature, bug, or idea — and turn it into a sensible set of tickets. Use for 'new project', 'I've got an idea', 'add a feature', 'file a bug', 'scope this', 'kick off'. Or point it at an existing ticket (`/faff-jot ISSUE-XX`) to load and inspect it — its shaping verbs are deferred, so it displays the ticket and mutates nothing.

name: faff-map
description: Explain the strategic roadmap: outcome initiatives, workstreams, dependency chains and trigger gates. Use for big-picture plans, strategy or roadmap coherence.

name: faff-onboard
description: First-run repository setup: detect tracker, repository and git host, ask for missing facts, and write valid .faff/config.yaml. Use to onboard or configure faff.

name: faff-plot
description: Plan an application-scale idea as initiatives, projects and first-slice epics. Use rehome to group loose Backlog work into human-confirmed outcome projects.

name: faff-prep
description: Turn a vague ticket into something you can actually build — explores the codebase, writes a spec, attaches it to the issue. Trigger for: 'prep ISSUE-XX' / 'prep this' / 'spec this out' / 'what does this ticket need?'.

name: faff-tidy
description: Groom the backlog: find duplicates, vague work, stale blockers and structural problems; promote ready issues to Todo. Use for tidy, clean up or groom.

name: faff-wtf
description: Brief on what shipped, what is blocked, what to work on next and what an unattended run parked. Use for catch me up, current focus or what happened.

name: faffidavit-rendering
description: Default rendering_adaptor: human-facing form, issue glosses, house voice and draft normalisation. No internal contract. Configured slot, not a user command.

name: faffidavit-routing
description: Default routing_adaptor slot: assign and render automation verdicts from diagnostics, confidence, markers and park history; validate assignments.

name: faffter-dark-adversarial-review
description: Use when the configured review slot requires a structural review plus an independent adversarial second opinion, or when invoked for an ADR drift or PRDR YAGNI challenge.

name: faffter-dark-authoring-adaptors
description: Author or validate a slot skill: scaffold adaptors, producers or methodologies against the fixed gateway contract and check conformance.

name: faffter-dark-concurrency-parallel
description: Parallel concurrency slot: execute beep-boop builds in capped concurrent worktrees, with rebase before merge. Alternative to the sequential default.

name: faffter-dark-methodology-agile-delivery
description: Agile-delivery methodology slot: answer backlog/build requests using seven delivery principles, right-sizing, value/risk order and surfaced dependencies.

name: faffter-dark-nlspec
description: Formal, full nlspec producer for the spec slot via faff-prep. Use when the configured spec format requires the heavier alternative to lite-nlspec.

name: faffter-dark-spec-review
description: L4 spec_review slot: independent architectural, infosec, methodology and QA refuters; aggregate enabled lenses by majority/severity into the fixed verdict.

name: faffter-noon-adr
description: Default adr producer: author a settled architecture decision from spec rationale and the ADR log, using the committed adr.md template or Nygard format.

name: faffter-noon-architecture
description: Default architecture slot: propose a build-biased production architecture from the infrastructure profile and brief/spec; emit proposal and ADR promotion intent.

name: faffter-noon-concurrency-sequential
description: Default concurrency slot: execute the beep-boop build pass one faff-graft at a time, avoiding concurrent worktree and merge conflicts.

name: faffter-noon-env-code-interface
description: Default env-code-interface slot under env: build a component from its Tier-1 binding manifest and provision a health-checked Node reflection bridge service.

name: faffter-noon-env-compose
description: Default env provisioner: create a representative Docker Compose stand-in from architecture/profile, seed synthetic data, and return a health-checked env-handle.

name: faffter-noon-evaluate
description: Default code-blind evaluator slot: judge routed DoD criteria against a running environment, mark unjudgeable prose needs-human, emit holdout verdict and tear down.

name: faffter-noon-intake
description: Default intake/discovery producer: turn an idea, bug or empty repository into a discovery brief for faff-jot or faff-plot through a light conversation.

name: faffter-noon-methodology-thematic
description: Default `methodology` lens (`thematic`) — opinion-free analysis that reflects the tracker topology: ordering by unlock value, gating on decision closure, composing the shared structural/topology floor (cycle + ghost-project detection). The zero-config baseline every pass uses. Runs as a configured slot, not the user `/` menu.

name: faffter-noon-prd
description: Default code-blind prd slot: judge machine-verifiable PRD stop conditions and creative licence; emit prd-readiness for the deterministic L4 run-start gate.

name: faffter-noon-review
description: Default review slot via faff-graft: senior-engineer diff review for acceptance coverage, bugs, scope and human judgement; return a review verdict.

name: faffter-noon-ship
description: Default ship producer: merge a gate-cleared PR through the merge-gate interlock, with no-op deployment; return native delivery result and delivery-outcome.

name: faffter-noon-spec
description: Default spec producer via faff-prep: turn an issue and explore findings into lite-nlspec (WHY-WHAT-HOW-DONE) with a confidence self-rating.

name: faffter-noon-spec-review
description: Default L1-L3 spec_review slot: one architectural, infosec, methodology and QA checklist pass over a freshly rated spec; emit a founded spec-review verdict.

name: faffter-noon-transport-private-network
description: Default transport slot: resolve the evaluator host over a private network whose segmentation provides evaluator-only access to the system under build.
